sentence: This project develops methods that combine data from multiple studies to better estimate how well treatments work for opioid use disorder.
This project studies the structure and interactions of condensates in bacteria to learn how they help bacteria adapt.
This project tries to find out whether attracting natural killer cells to tumor cells can improve immunotherapy for pancreatic cancer.
This project studies how Streptococcus mutans uses networks of interacting proteins to regulate gene expression.
This project uses mammalian cell genetics to study membrane biology, lipid transport and the regulation of lipid synthesis.
This project tries to find out how genes and the host environment shape inflammatory bowel diseases and resistance to treatment.
This project builds a platform that delivers CRISPR therapeutics to target methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus without affecting host cells.
This project studies how respiroviruses bind and fuse with host cell membranes, using artificial lipid membranes.
This project tries to find out how missing dystrophin leads to cardiac arrhythmias in cardiomyocytes made from human induced pluripotent stem cells.
This project studies how microbes and the chemicals they produce change insect senses, including how mosquitoes find people and crop pests choose plants.
This project builds an ultra-low field MRI method for breast cancer screening and tests how well it detects cancer in patients.
This project builds viral vectors that target trigeminal ganglion nociceptors to deliver targeted pain relief for chronic craniofacial pain.
This project studies how regulatory T cells suppress the immune response in human breast cancer and tries to develop ways to control it.
This project studies the biological causes of cognitive impairment, depression, anxiety and fatigue in people with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus using brain imaging.
This project provides musculoskeletal tissues, cells, RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics services to support musculoskeletal research.
This project studies how problems with intestinal fluid secretion lead to chronic constipation, using samples from patients.
This project maps RNA transcripts in brain cell types and layers to find genes that differ between suicides, depressed subjects and neurotypical controls.
This project sets up a scanning electron microscope to look at tissues, cells, bacteria, fungi and viruses in 3D.
This project builds a modular platform for bioluminescence imaging of small animal models with automated image data analysis.
This project builds a cranial ultrasound patch that measures ventricular size and cerebral blood flow in neonates with germinal matrix hemorrhage.
